adapter.reason.noAdapter: Unavailable: no AYAR adapter reads the results of {tool}, so there is no verdict without evidence. Define it as a custom check with a success criterion
adapter.reason.noCommand: Unavailable: this check has no command
adapter.reason.compositeScript: Composite script: it runs as approved, and calling {tool} directly is suggested
adapter.reason.configError: Unavailable: a configuration error in {tool} (code {code}); the problem is the tool or its configuration, not the project: {detail}
adapter.reason.conflictExitPass: Unavailable: conflicting evidence — {tool} exited with {exit} and its report lists failures ({failed})
adapter.reason.conflictExitFail: Unavailable: conflicting evidence — {tool} exited with {exit} and its report lists no failure
adapter.reason.unknownExit: Unavailable: an unknown exit code from {tool} ({code})
adapter.reason.stoppedBeforeTests: Unavailable: {tool} stopped before any test; the problem is the environment or the configuration: {detail}
adapter.reason.pytestNoTests: Missing: no tests were collected (pytest code 5)
adapter.reason.pytestInterrupted: Unavailable: pytest was interrupted before it completed (code 2): {detail}
adapter.reason.tscConfig: Unavailable: a TypeScript configuration error ({code}); the problem is the configuration, not the code: {detail}
adapter.reason.unparsedDiagnostics: Unavailable: {tool} reported errors (code {code}) that could not be read: {detail}
adapter.reason.noInputFiles: Missing: no files for {tool} to check
adapter.reason.noLinksChecked: Missing: no web link was checked ({links} links, {excluded} of them excluded as local or not web); AYAR knocks on no local address
adapter.reason.noMutants: Missing: no valid mutants to measure
adapter.reason.loadThresholds: Failed: the load test went beyond its declared thresholds
adapter.reason.osvDbMissing: Missing: the local vulnerability database is not there
adapter.reason.osvExtraction: Unavailable: a lock file could not be read (the tool, not the project): {detail}
adapter.reason.noSuccessCriterion: Unavailable: this custom check declares no success criterion
adapter.reason.noTargets: Missing: no files with the extensions {extensions} for {tool} to check
adapter.reason.noGitRepository: Missing: no Git repository whose history can be read
adapter.note.directCallSuggested: Composite script; calling the tool directly is suggested so AYAR gets its whole report
adapter.note.untestedVersion: Run with a tool version outside the range its adapter was tested with, accepted once
adapter.suggest.directCall: Call the tool directly with the same options, so it writes its report where AYAR reads it
adapter.limits.tests: Proves the results of the tests that ran, not the absence of bugs in what was not tested
adapter.limits.lint: Proves the linter rules the project enables, nothing more
adapter.limits.types: Proves what the type checker sees; what a comment or an open type silences does not show
adapter.limits.unused: Sees what its entry points reach; dynamic use may look unused
adapter.limits.build: Proves the build succeeded, not that its output works
adapter.limits.sast: Finds the known patterns of its rules only
adapter.limits.deps: Finds the vulnerabilities known to the local database as of its date
adapter.limits.secrets: Finds secrets by their known patterns; a secret in an unusual form may slip by
adapter.limits.links: Proves the links as they were at the time of the run; 401, 403 and 429 stay undecided
adapter.limits.mutation: Measures mutants in the configured files only
adapter.limits.load: Proves the declared scenario under its load only
adapter.limits.custom: AYAR does not know what the command means; its declared criterion decides
